targets.name: Janus Kinase 1
targets.mechanism: Inhibition prevents CD8+ cytotoxic T-cell recruitment and killing of epidermal melanocytes

targets.name: Janus Kinase 2
targets.mechanism: Synergistic inhibition with JAK1 halts autoimmune depigmentation cascade

targets.name: Melanocortin 1 Receptor
targets.mechanism: Agonism/stimulation drives melanocyte stem cell (McSC) differentiation and melanin synthesis

targets.name: Tyrosinase
targets.mechanism: Cofactor activation/stabilization accelerates pigment production in recovered melanocytes

targets.name: Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 / KEAP1
targets.mechanism: Activating Nrf2 neutralizes reactive oxygen species (H2O2) that trigger autoimmune vitiligo flares
